propositions: Universal uv resolution downgrades pydantic-ai-slim to 1.38.0 due to disjoint boto3 constraints between [eval]→inspect-ai→aiobotocore (pins boto3>=1.40.46,<1.40.62) and [bedrock]/[dev]→pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]>=1.107 (requires boto3>=1.42.63), breaking AnthropicModel import

pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 + anthropic 0.120.2 fails at import time when AnthropicModel tries to access UserLocation from anthropic.types.beta.beta_web_search_tool_20250305_param (renamed in newer anthropic)
pip-provisioned envs resolve correctly to pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.1 + anthropic 0.120.2 (installs per-extra, avoiding joint resolution), while uv-provisioned envs pick the downgraded 1.38.0

Adding [tool.uv] conflicts block for eval⊥bedrock and eval⊥dev, plus floor pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries]>=1.107,<2, resolves to healthy pair (1.107.1 + 0.120.2) without breaking eval+agents co-install

Commit landing fixes local uv envs by raising [agents] floor to >=1.107 and declaring extras conflicts; regression guard is CI smoke test verifying AnthropicModel import succeeds in locked dev environment
